notes.title: Onboarding Program for New Reclaimers!
notes.content:
Hello reclaimers!

Right in time for the Steam Scream 3  the Governor has created an onboarding program for all new Reclaimers!

Now, you'll be able to enjoy a tutorial that teaches you the basics when you start the game for the first time! The tutorial can be restarted or stopped from the options menu.


I've also implemented a more consistent saving system to ensure your loot is stored safely whenever you decide to stop scavenging.


Along with these, some minors bugs and fixes have been created, allowing for a smoother experience for you.

Additionally, I've addressed some minor bugs and made fixes for a smoother experience.

Thank you to everyone who provided feedback over the past few weeks, helping me deliver faster and more accurate updates for Echoes Afterfall.

Keep scavenging, and we'll get back to you soon.

The Governor salutes you.

notes.title: June State of The Game
notes.content:
Hello Reclaimers!

I'm excited to share the latest updates and ongoing developments for Echoes Afterfall. Here’s what I’ve been working on during this time:

New Enemies!

The Stalker: This chilling new enemy will silently observe you, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. As soon as he finds you, he'll just look at you for a while, until he's done with just watching you... You better run and keep out of his line of sight!


Mysterious Entity: There's also a new eerie presence in the game. Won't be easy to catch it off guard... but surely it will catch you.

Playtester Feedback

A huge thank you to all the playtesters! Your feedback is invaluable and is helping me make the game better with each update. Keep the suggestions and critiques coming; they are crucial to the development process.

What’s Next?

I'm currently developing the Equipment System that I'm sure will enhance your gameplay experience. This will offer more options and variety in your expeditions.

Finishing Off the Maps: Finalizing the first 3 maps for the Early Access release is a top priority. I’m polishing them to ensure a rich and immersive experience for you.

Stay tuned for more updates and keep the feedback coming. Your input is crucial to the development of Echoes Afterfall!

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm!

Stay brave, stay sharp, and happy scavenging!

notes.title: Playtest for Echoes Afterfall
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the closed playtest for Echoes Afterfall will begin on June 28th! This is your exclusive chance to dive into the post-apocalyptic world, explore the haunting Echoes, and help us shape the future of the game, while getting the opportunity to get access to the complete game for free once released!

Key Details:

Start Date: June 28th
Available Spots: 50
Feedback Reward: Free keys for those who share detailed feedback. Each player will be eligible for only 1 Key giveaway for Echoes Afterfall (if you win one key, you won't be able to win another one in the future by providing feedback).

Key giveway valid for feedbacks sent from the Playtest start to July 1st, 12:00 PST *


How to Play:

Sign Up on the game page: 50 random players will be givend the access to the game
Play the Game: Dive into the Echoes and experience the intense cooperative horror survival gameplay.
Share Your Feedback: Provide us with detailed feedback on your experience. You can do so by using the in game feedback feature provided and living a contact, or contacting me directly via Twitter/X clicking here. **
Get a Free Key: As a token of my appreciation, everyone who shares their feedback will receive a free key to the game.***

Join the Adventure:
I'm excited to have you join us on this journey. Your participation and feedback will be crucial in shaping the final game. Let’s work together to rebuild the world in Echoes Afterfall.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. I can’t wait to hear about your experiences and see you in the Echoes!

Stay brave, stay sharp, and happy scavenging!



*Validity of key giveways for supporters will be defined on each announcement. Make sure to check the latest announcements to understand all the informations regarding new Echoes Afterfall giveways 

**The contact will only be used to send you the key and won't be used again from me to contact you.

***Keys will be sent to eligible player every Friday. Make sure to leave a contact way for me to send the Key

notes.title: DEMO NOW AVAIABLE!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave Reclaimers!

I am thrilled to announce that the demo for Echoes Afterfall is now live! Dive into the eerie world of the Echoes and experience the thrill of survival in a post-apocalyptic setting.

The demo was initially released yesterday, but I took an extra day to implement some fixes based on initial feedback before officially announcing its availability. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

This demo will be available for a limited time, running until May 24th. Don't miss your chance to explore the Echoes and share your feedback with us!

In this demo, you'll step into the shoes of a Reclaimer and venture into the procedurally generated Echoes. Gather vital resources, face unexpected challenges, and work together with other players to survive.

Your feedback is crucial as we continue to develop and refine the game. Share your thoughts directly through the in-game form or on our Steam Community page.

Thank you for your support, and I can't wait to hear about your adventures in the Echoes!

Prepare to dive in, survive, and maybe... change the fate of the world.

notes.title: Welcome to Echoes Afterfall – A Personal Message from the Developer
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm thrilled to finally introduce myself and my project, Echoes Afterfall, to the Steam community. As the solo developer behind this game, I've poured my heart and soul into creating a cooperative horror survival experience set in a post-apocalyptic world that I hope you'll find exciting.

In Echoes Afterfall, you take on the role of a Reclaimer, a brave soul tasked with venturing into mysterious zones known as Echoes to recover resources essential for humanity’s survival. These Echoes are procedurally generated environments filled with both treasures and traps, designed to test your survival skills and sanity to the limits.

I am excited to announce that the first playable demo of Echoes Afterfall will be released on May 10th and will stay live until May 24th. This demo is your gateway into the twisted world of the Echoes, where you'll face various challenges, manage resources, and work together with other players to survive, but most importantly, satisfy the Governor.

Your Feedback is Crucial
As we approach this milestone, your feedback will be invaluable. The demo is an opportunity for you to explore the core mechanics of the game, and for me to learn from your experiences to improve and expand. I am particularly eager to hear your thoughts on:

The game’s combat and survival mechanics

 Your experiences with multiplayer interactions
 The balance of challenge versus fun in the procedurally generated Echoes
 You can share your feedback directly through the in-game form or on our Steam Community page.


Every piece of feedback will be considered deeply as I continue to develop and refine the game.

Thank you so much for your interest and support. It means the world to me to have you join this adventure. I am eager to see how you will tackle the challenges of the Echoes and to hear all the stories you’ll have to tell.

Prepare to dive in, survive, and maybe... change the fate of the world.
